title: PRESSER | Desrae Kyles & Rachael Okokoh - LA Tech Postgame (11-15-26)
text: We have Rachel Cocco and Desiree. Um, y'all can go ahead and ask questions. >> Desiree, first start of the year, I know you were dealing with a little bit of an injury coming into the season. To get your first start today, 10 rebounds, how did it feel to, you know, get out there in your full minutes? >> I mean, it felt good. I just I just wanted to perform well. I got a chance to start. I felt like I had to step up and do what I have to do and just play hard and just take opportunity and do what I can do with it. >> And with it being early in the season for both of you, how do you deal with just the constant rotation trying to find that true starting five so far? >> This one here? >> Uh, either of you. >> Oh, I mean, we just Coach she she tried to rotate everybody to see which one going to be the best start, whether it's going to be the first part of the game, second half. She going to change it up a lot. We just got to make sure we do do our part with taking our opportunity and running with it. >> Rachel, you were perfect from the field tonight, four for four this afternoon, four and then six rebounds on top of that. What was working for you specifically? >> Uh, I feel like what was working for me was what I've been practicing in practice. So just we worked on the sliding the slides, setting good screens, and just rebounding, just doing things like that. >> Uh, a bit of a late push from Louisiana Tech. In that moment, how what is it what goes through your mind to kind of bear down and not let them get back in it uh late in the game? >> Um, I feel like they was going to speed us up. That's kind of one of the things Coach told us. So just trusting our preparation, knowing that we had to slow down and not let them speed us up, do what we do best, dictate, and also on offense just taking our time and um executing. >> And with this is just such a new group. It's so early in the year. Another big test on Wednesday against Ohio State. Just how do you guys continue to grow in that and what what can you kind of work on before Wednesday? >> Um, we going to watch a lot of film with Coach. So she going to have a lot of stuff that she want us to fix. So just listen, getting ready for the next next game on Wednesday and just trust the preparation. >> What what is the biggest thing you guys think you can work on just early on far? >> I say >> our >> Yeah, for sure. >> Yeah, it's a lot of stuff we know we know we can do. We just got to communicate a little better and it'll be better. >> All right. Thank you, guys.
